title: NIST WebBook: hydrogen fluoride is FH, molecular weight 20.00634 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists hydrogen fluoride as FH, molecular weight 20.00634 amu, CAS 7664-39-3.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for hydrogen fluoride, CAS Registry Number 7664-39-3, lists molecular formula FH and molecular weight 20.00634 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 20.00622825 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/FH/h1H. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
